sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a reservoir centre reimagined into a retreat to support student wellbeing is among the projects from Regent's University London. Also featured is another reservoir centre used as a hub for food cultivation and a wellness hotel, designed to give visitors a break from intense city life.
